Subject: Veridian: technical deep-dive times + traffic snapshot request

Hi Chris / Asha,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great to learn how Veridian is thinking about embedding LLMs into clinical triage. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive and sizing call: 

- Recap: You want a demo of our prompt flow + a technical deep-dive to validate throughput/latency with a dedicated GPU pool. Primary goals: sub-200ms token latency for inference at 1k concurrent sessions and a plan for burst to 5k.
- Next meeting: Combining demo + dedicated-capacity sizing feels best (30–45m demo, 45–60m sizing).

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Tue Jun 15 — 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Jun 16 — 14:00–15:30

Can you confirm which works, or send a couple windows that do? If you pick one, we’ll send a calendar invite (ICS) and a short pre-call checklist.

To make the sizing productive, can you drop a short sample of expected traffic (QPS, average sequence length, typical batch size) before the call? I’ve attached a tiny template you can fill (veridian_throughput_template.xlsx) — a one-sheet CSV is great too.

Attachments: veridian_throughput_template.xlsx (template for QPS/sequence-length/burst profile)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

—Jonas

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the template. Wed Jun 16 at 14:00 PT works best for our team. I populated the attached CSV with a short 48-hour sample and a conservative burst estimate; key highlights:

- Steady: ~1k active sessions (avg) hitting inference every ~8s (~125 QPS)
- Typical token length: 120 tokens response average (prompt+response ~200 tokens)
- Peak burst during morning triage: up to 5k concurrent sessions (~625 QPS) for 2–3 minute windows

We’d like the call to validate latency at sustained 125 QPS and to map a plan for the morning burst. Please confirm that Ben (SE) will join the sizing portion to speak to batching/quantization options.

Attachment: veridian_traffic_sample.csv

—Chris
